episodes.name: The Picnic Panic
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends attend their high school picnic at the Centerville Picnic Grounds, but when the Yancy Street Gang shows up at the picnic and causes trouble, The Thing must save the day.

episodes.name: Bigfoot Meets the Thing
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends confront a real Bigfoot while on a ski trip at North Woods Ski Lodge.

episodes.name: Junkyard Hijinks
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends decide to transform the Yancy Street Gang's junkyard into a playground for the neighborhood children.

episodes.name: Gone Away Gulch
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends visit the town of Gone Away Gulch and, during a storm, the group seeks shelter in a deserted hotel haunted by an old prospector.

episodes.name: Circus Stampede
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends attend the Barney and Baillum Circus where the Yancy Street Gang sets loose a mouse, causing the elephants to stampede and all the other animals to escape.

episodes.name: The Thing and the Queen
episodes.overviewEn: When Betty runs for homecoming queen, the Yancy Street Gang (whose friend Sophie is also vying for the same title) resorts to their usual dirty tactics as they try to sabotage Betty's campaign.

episodes.name: Carnival Caper
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends visit a local carnival and, after stopping a runaway ferris wheel and fixing it, The Thing is offered a job at the carnival by its owner.

episodes.name: The Thing Blanks Out
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends enjoy a trip aboard Ronald's father's yacht; Thing saves the group from crashing into a downed drawbridge, but then he is stricken with amnesia following the closing drawbridge's impact on his head.

episodes.name: The Thing Meets the Clunk
episodes.overviewEn: Dr. Quimby introduces his latest invention – a robot called Clunk who is programmed to do good – however, the robot malfunctions, goes out-of-control and causes trouble for The Thing.

episodes.name: Beach Party Crashers
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy attends a beachside surf party with Kelly, Betty, Ronald and Miss Twilly, but the Yancy Street Gang are up to their old tricks as they crash the party and sabotage a volleyball game.

episodes.name: Decepto the Great
episodes.overviewEn: A magician, Decepto the Great, performs his magic show at the high school fair, but Benjy discovers Decepto is stealing from the school kids and it's up to The Thing to stop him from escaping town.

episodes.name: The Thing's the Play
episodes.overviewEn: Betty studies with acting teacher Ferdinand Bestmore so she can audition for a TV crew coming to Centerville High School to shoot a commercial; however, Bestmore confuses Betty with an old actress he once discovered and whom she resembles so he kidnaps her.

episodes.name: Double Trouble for the Thing
episodes.overviewEn: An evil scientist named Danton Blackwood creates a robot Thing to commit crime to make the citizens believe The Thing has gone bad, but which also lands the real Thing in jail.

episodes.name: To Thing or Not to Thing
The Big Bike Race
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy enters a cross country bike race because the winner gets to escort the Race Queen to the dance.

episodes.name: The Thing and the Treasure Hunt
Out to Launch
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends are going to a ship launching but the world's greatest demolition expert intends to ruin the day.

episodes.name: The Day the Ring Didn't Do a Thing
episodes.overviewEn: The Yancy Street Gang decides to steal Benjy's ring, causing no end of trouble for The Thing.

episodes.name: A Hot Air Affair at the Fair
The Thing Goes to the Dogs
episodes.overviewEn: Ronald has entered his dog Countess in the Centerville Dog Show, but chaos ensues when Countess is dognapped by the troublesome Yancy Street Gang and it's up to The Thing to rescue her.

episodes.name: The Thing Goes Camping
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy, his friends and Miss Twilly go on a camping trip as part of a special school project which is anything but relaxing with a bear running loose at their campsite and a big storm triggering a landslide that threatened the entire camp.

episodes.name: Photo Finish
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy accompanies his friends to the Centerville Zoo which is sponsoring a photo contest and the Yancy Street Gang resorts to their usual dirty tactics to win.

episodes.name: Lights, Action, Thing!
episodes.overviewEn: Ronald and Betty are hired to appear in a movie currently filming at a local lake, but problems occur when a mechanical octopus monster (controlled by an angry stuntman) attacks the set, trying to sabotage the entire production.

episodes.name: The Thing and the Captain's Ghost
episodes.overviewEn: The Yancy Street Gang dares Ben and his friends to stay on a haunted ship for a night.

episodes.name: The Thing and the Absent-Minded Inventor
episodes.overviewEn: Benjy and his friends attend Centerville's annual inventors show where they meet the absent-minded Fenwick Twilly (Miss Twilly's uncle) who unveils his gigantic vacuum cleaner Supervac, which sucks everything in sight and destroys all the other inventions during its rampage.
